title: Mobile Buttons
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mobile
learningObjectives: Explain why canvas-drawn rectangle buttons fail on mobile Safari, since touch events are dispatched separately from mousePressed() and canvas scaling remaps touch coordinates
Compare native p5.js createButton() HTML elements against canvas-drawn buttons on touch support, keyboard and screen-reader accessibility, CSS styling, and show()/hide() state management
Trace how touchStarted(), touchMoved(), and touchEnded() route into a shared handleInteraction(px, py) function that serves both mouse and touch input
Apply pixelDensity(1) and enlarged hit targets to correct coordinate mapping on high-DPI displays and make controls touch-friendly
